name: Decart
tagline: Real-time generative world and video models (Oasis, Lucy).
description: Decart is an AI lab building real-time generative world and video models, including Oasis (a fully AI-generated, playable Minecraft-style open world) and Lucy (real-time video transformation used in gaming, ads, and virtual try-on). Its Oasis 3 is positioned as an API-accessible world model for Physical AI, with a low-latency inference stack. Products are accessed via the platform API and interactive demos.
insight: Raised $32M at a $500M valuation (Dec 2024, Benchmark), then $300M at ~$3.1B (Aug 2025); founders came out of IDF Unit 8200.
edge: Generates fully playable, frame-by-frame AI worlds in real time (Oasis) — a category most 'game AI' tools don't touch.

references.title: Decart adds another $32M at a $500M valuation
